milestone: Milestone 1 — Descriptor contracts and shadow ownership

rollback.scope: Disable only the read-only Milestone 1 observer; keep the authoritative V1 loader and all installed plugin data unchanged.
procedure: Set OR3_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_SHADOW_ENABLED=false outside the plugin admin UI.
Restart the OR3 process before any non-core plugin executes.
Verify the Runtime Inspector reports V1 only and run the maintained V1 corpus.
Keep the observer disabled if the complete Milestone 0 qualification is not green.
rollback.drill: The observer-rollback-drill gate proves the V1 import/register trace remains exact and observer dependencies are never constructed; the frozen-v1-qualification gate then re-runs all Milestone 0 exit gates.
